title: Longevity
subtitle: 「長壽／長使用壽命／持久性」，究竟是哪一種 longevity？
description: 「長壽／長使用壽命／持久性」，究竟是哪一種 longevity？

words.note: 最直接、最自然的日常改寫，表示人或動物活得很久。比 longevity 更口語，也更直接描述結果。
words.example: A balanced diet may contribute to a long life.

exercises.original: The village is known for the longevity of many of its residents.
exercises.zh: 這條村以很多居民長壽而聞名。
exercises.upgrade: long life · 長壽；長久生命

falseSynonyms.zh: lifespan 只是生命或使用期長度，可長可短；longevity 通常帶『長久』本身的突出意味。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The species has a lifespan of about ten years. The species is known for its longevity.

falseSynonyms.zh: life expectancy 是統計上的預期壽命；longevity 可指個人實際長壽或一般長久性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Life expectancy at birth rose to 82 years. Her family is known for exceptional longevity.

falseSynonyms.zh: survival 只表示活下來／繼續存在；不一定表示活得很久。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Early treatment improves survival. Longevity refers to unusually long life or duration.

falseSynonyms.zh: immortality 是不死／永生，概念遠強於長壽。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The story imagines human immortality. The study examines factors associated with longevity.

falseSynonyms.zh: age 是年齡或存在時間；它不是『長壽』本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON His age is 90. His longevity is unusual in his family.

falseSynonyms.zh: durability 適合物品、材料、系統；人的壽命通常不用 durability。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The coating improves the material's durability. Regular exercise may contribute to human longevity.

falseSynonyms.zh: healthy life expectancy 是預期在良好健康狀態下生活的年數，不等於總壽命。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Healthy life expectancy measures expected years in good health. Longevity concerns how long life lasts overall.

falseSynonyms.zh: long 是形容詞；longevity 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The species has a long lifespan. The species is known for its longevity.
